title: Derived counit completion from a bounded flat stalk complex
statement: Under the affine presentation hypothesis, let p:Y→B be qcqs, M a relatively flat quasi-coherent module, g:A→B and a∈A. Given affine opens S⊆B and V⊆A containing g(a) and a with V⊆g⁻¹(S), and a StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation of p|S, M restricted to p⁻¹(S), and g|V:S, there exists a bounded-above termwise-flat complex P over O_B,g(a), a universal derived scalar-extension pair for g.stalkMap(a), and the original localization homology identifications and counit compatibility in every integer degree. P is existential, constructed from the stalk of that same local sheaf complex.

proof.text: Pending proof: unpack the given local presentation; construct P termwise from its K by exact stalks and the open-stalk ring isomorphism. Use the derived stalk extension comparison, its counit equation, and exact-stalk homology comparison. Transport the direct-image and pullback identifications through open restriction, whose canonical mate identifies the local base-change map with the original one. Apply homology in every degree. See the complete declaration docstring.

theorem standardSingleFlatCounit_localization_completion
    (h_affine : ∀ {Y₀ B₀ A₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p₀ : Y₀ ⟶ B₀)
      [QuasiCompact p₀] [QuasiSeparated p₀] [IsAffine B₀] [IsAffine A₀]
      (g₀ : A₀ ⟶ B₀), StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p₀ g₀ ⊤)
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (hM : M.IsFlatOver p) (g : A ⟶ B) (a : A)
    (S : B.Opens) (V : A.Opens) (hS : g a ∈ S) (hV : a ∈ V)
    (hSaff : IsAffine S.toScheme) (hVaff : IsAffine V.toScheme)
    (hVS : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ S)
    (hpres : StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation (p ∣_ S)
      (M.restrict (p ⁻¹ᵁ S).ι) (g.resLE S V hVS)) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let R := B.presheaf.stalk (g a)
    let T := A.presheaf.stalk a
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} R)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} T)
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ),
      (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (P.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Flat R (P.X i)) ∧
      ∃ (LF : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} T))
        (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LF ⟶
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (g.stalkMap a).hom).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Qh),
        LF.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ,
          ∃ (eL : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor A.toRingedSpace a).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
                ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage p).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))) ≅
              (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
                (LF.obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                  ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))))
            (eR : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
                (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                  (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (g.stalkMap a).hom).mapHomotopyCategory
                    (.up ℤ)).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))) ≅
              (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor A.toRingedSpace a).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
                  ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd p g)).obj
                    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
                      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst p g) M))))),
            (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor A.toRingedSpace a).map
                ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).map (standardSingleBaseChangeMap p M g)) =
              eL.hom ≫ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).map
                (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫ eR.hom

statement_change.old_statement: Under the affine open presentation hypothesis, given a bounded-above termwise-flat stalk complex P over the base stalk ring, the derived scalar-extension functor, counit, all homology identifications, and the required compatibility square exist.
statement_change.what: The old arbitrary-P conclusion is false: identity maps on Spec(k), M=O, P=0 would identify zero with k. Require the actual presentation on affine S and V (including e, t and their equation), not a nonexistent global presentation. Construct P from its K. Parent signature is preserved.
